title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 254 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 154 - Right of an Agent to Recover Paid Tax (1) An agent who, on account of his liabilities under section 252, pays any amount, shall be entitled to recover such amount paid from the person on whose behalf he paid the amount, or in his possession because of being an agent or there is a possibility of getting it, in his possession the amount equal to the amount paid can be recovered from such money. (2) any representative, or any other person who may be deemed to be an agent, is liable to pay tax under section 252 on behalf of the person (hereinafter referred to as the “beneficiary”) from any amount payable to that beneficiary such amount not exceeding tax liability can be recovered. (3) In the event of any disagreement between the beneficiary and the agent or as the case may be the person in apprehension of being assessed as an agent as to the amount to be withheld under sub-section-2, the agent or the person by obtaining certificate from the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes, stating such amount can guarantee that be said amount will be withheld or deferred until the tax is settled and the certificate so obtained shall be considered as a warrant for withholding the said amount.
